title: Comparative outcomes of DSAEK and DMEK in eyes with prior Ahmed glaucoma valve implantation

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution License, ext-link https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

indication: Endothelial keratoplasty in eyes with a prior Ahmed glaucoma valve (single or multiple AGV, some with prior trabeculectomy/MIGS; POAG, secondary, uveitic, pseudoexfoliative, neovascular glaucoma, ICE syndrome; Table 1); no previous corneal transplantation; mostly pseudophakic

groups.description: Ultrathin DSAEK (precut eye-bank tissue, graft thickness under 100 um, pull-through insertion with Endoglide or Macaluso inserter, filtered-air tamponade); technique chosen by surgeon preference; retrospective consecutive series 2020-2022
DMEK (precut, preloaded eye-bank grafts in bent-pipette glass tubes, filtered-air tamponade); technique chosen by surgeon preference; retrospective consecutive series 2020-2022

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of the operated eye (Table 5 row 'Preoperative'); ultrasound pachymeter SP-3000, Tomey (Methods)
series.notes: Table 5 column 'DSAEK (n = 16)'; mean ± standard deviation of CCT (total corneal thickness by ultrasound; host and graft are not separated). n_by_time: header n for the preoperative, 1- and 3-month rows; footnotes ‡ (6 months, n = 16) and § (12 months, n = 14); Results: eyes with graft failure by a visit were excluded from that visit's analysis.

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT of the operated eye (Table 5 row 'Preoperative'); ultrasound pachymeter SP-3000, Tomey (Methods)
series.notes: Table 5 column 'DMEK (n = 11)'; mean ± standard deviation of CCT by ultrasound. n_by_time: header n for the preoperative, 1- and 3-month rows; footnotes ‡ (6 months, n = 10) and § (12 months, n = 10); Results: eyes with graft failure by a visit were excluded from that visit's analysis.

exclusions.what: Table 5 'Mean Difference (95% CI)' and 'P value' columns
exclusions.reason: Between-group differences and p-values are not admissible
Graft-only thickness of the donor tissue, not central corneal thickness of the operated eye

notes: DSAEK and DMEK are two standard techniques chosen by surgeon preference, no investigational agent: both control-role groups with per-group procedure contexts (dsaek, dmek).

Failed grafts were removed from later visits (5/16 DSAEK and 3/11 DMEK secondary failures overall); the groups are defined by procedure, not by a postoperative outcome, so they are kept and the attrition is shown in n_by_time.
CCT was assessed by ultrasound pachymetry (SP-3000; Tomey) at follow-up visits; graft attachment by AS-OCT (ANTERION) is not a CCT source in Table 5.
